item.title: Re-listed Baileys Harbor shipwreck added to National Register of Historic Places
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A shipwreck near Baileys Harbor that had gone by a different name for more than 20 years has now been added to the National Register of Historic Places.

item.title: Door County Advances Plan for Mid-County EMS Ambulance Station
item.description: Adam Collins -- Door County Emergency Services is moving forward with plans to build a new mid-county ambulance station intended to significantly improve emergency response times for residents and visitors.

item.title: Warm-up could be detrimental to ice fishing conditions
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- While you may be celebrating temperatures hitting 40 degrees over the next few days, your neighbors who enjoy ice fishing and other winter sports activities may not be as excited.

item.title: Gibraltar community gathers around alum Jackson
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A week after showing its support for Sevastopol third-grader Violet Tanck at a boys basketball game earlier this week, the Gibraltar community is hoping to do the same for one of its own.

item.title: Man dies in Forestville farming accident
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Door County Sheriff's Office is investigating a fatal farming accident that occurred on Thursday in the Town of Forestville.

item.title: Baileys Harbor Talk to Spotlight Room Tax Role in Local Economy
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Baileys Harbor Community Association will spotlight Door County's room tax and its impact on the local economy during the next Talk of the Town session on Thursday, February 26, at Lake Fire Winery.

item.title: BUG Fire Department loses member to cancer
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Brussels-Union-Gardner Fire Department said goodbye to one of its own Thursday after announcing that longtime member Ryan Chaudoir lost his battle with cancer.

item.title: Destination Door County grants nearly $350,000 through Community Investment Fund
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Safer events, new trails and facility enhancements are among the improvements visitors will see throughout the peninsula thanks to local room tax dollars and Destination Door County.

item.title: Independent Book Stores see Rise in Traffic
item.description: Adam Collins -- Independent bookstores once thought to be fading in the wake of online retailers and the American Booksellers Association reports a different story.

item.title: Forestville Man Identified In Fatal Farm Accident
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County Sheriff's Office investigating a fatal farming accident that occurred Thursday afternoon have identified the victim as 50-year-old Wilson Duarte Martinez of Forestville.
